svg.title: Kitchen lighting: 5 V APA102 best-practice breadboard layout
svg.desc: One USB-C input powers the Nano 33 IoT, SN74AHCT125N logic buffer and one to five APA102 pixels. J0 is an Adafruit 4090 USB-C breakout, with onboard CC pull-downs and its supplied header soldered into b54 through b61, socket facing left. VBUS at b55 and GND at b54 supply the rails; the other six pads have no external connections. The Nano VIN header at c15 connects locally through a15 to L+15, and Nano GND connects through a14 to L-14. Both rail pairs are linked, with wire bridges across all four midpoint breaks. Nano VUSB is unconnected; leave its VUSB solder bridge open. The Nano micro-USB socket is only needed for programming. Every jumper is drawn from hole to hole; crossings are insulated.
svg.text: One USB-C input → Nano VIN + LED/buffer 5 V

g.title: P1: a1 → a25. Nano D13 → U1 clock input pin 5
P2: i2 → a22. Nano D11 → U1 data input pin 2
O1: e31 → e41. R4 → strip CI / clock
O2: e28 → e42. R3 → strip DI / data
V0: e55 → R+55. USB-C J0 VBUS → right + rail
V1: j21 → R+21. +5 V → U1 VCC pin 14 / C1
V2: b43 → L+43. +5 V → strip positive
V3: a46 → L+46. +5 V → C2 positive
V4: j22 → R+22. Disable unused channel 4: pin 13 HIGH
V5: j25 → R+25. Disable unused channel 3: pin 10 HIGH
V6: a15 → L+15. USB-C +5 V → Nano VIN (c15 row)
N0: e54 → R-54. USB-C J0 GND → right − rail
N1: a14 → L-14. Shared ground → Nano GND
N2: a27 → L-27. Ground → U1 pin 7
N3: b40 → L-40. Ground → strip GND
N4: a48 → L-48. Ground → C2 negative
N5: a24 → L-24. Enable clock channel: pin 4 LOW
N6: a21 → L-21. Enable data channel: pin 1 LOW
N7: j26 → R-26. Unused input pin 9 → ground
N8: j23 → R-23. Unused input pin 12 / C1 → ground
B1: L+31 → L+34. Bridge left + rail midpoint break
B2: L-31 → L-34. Bridge left − rail midpoint break
B3: R+31 → R+34. Bridge right + rail midpoint break
B4: R-31 → R-34. Bridge right − rail midpoint break
B5: L+50 → R+50. Link left and right +5 V rails
B6: L-52 → R-52. Link left and right ground rails

svg.text: Nano VUSB solder bridge open · 5V / VUSB pin unused
